color-canvas: Window background behind the navigation and the work area. Never pure black or white.
color-surface: Primary work surface: the navigation pane, section blocks, fields and buttons, menus and dialogs.
color-surface-subtle: Hover and selected rows, the selected navigation item, secondary fills and code wells.
color-foreground: Primary text and icons on color-canvas, color-surface and color-surface-subtle.
color-muted: Secondary text (descriptions, metadata, key/value labels, inactive navigation icons) on color-canvas, color-surface and color-surface-subtle.
color-border: Hairline separators and the edges of sections and the navigation pane.
color-border-strong: Control edges (buttons, fields, the switch track, step circles), the language menu border and scrollbar thumbs.
color-primary: The one accent: selection markers, the filled primary action, checked switches and text actions. It is never body text on color-canvas.
color-on-primary: Text, glyphs and switch thumbs on a color-primary fill.
color-focus: The 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on every focusable control.
color-success: Verified and running state only: the overview state icon, check marks and state text. Never decorative.
color-warning: Attention state only: warning icons, warning text and notices. Never decorative.
color-destructive: Failure and destructive actions: danger buttons, inline errors, dialog validation messages, critical rows and notices, and the window close button's hover fill (with a white glyph).
color-preview: Ground of the preview canvas, profile thumbnails and specimen strips when the canvas follows the window theme. Helper bitmaps own their own colours on top of it.
space-1: 4px: gaps inside the navigation lists and between a heading and its description.
space-2: 8px: icon-to-label gaps, navigation item padding and the gap between header actions.
space-3: 12px: button side padding, navigation pane side padding and setting-row rhythm.
space-4: 16px: section heading and detail row padding, and the navigation pane's top padding.
space-5: 20px: the gap between navigation blocks and the Tuner's vertical padding.
space-6: 24px: page header bottom padding and the Tuner's side padding.
space-8: 32px: page padding and the gap between sections.
space-10: 40px: the largest step of the grid; declared for major regions and currently unused by the stylesheets.
radius-control: Corners of controls, navigation items, status bands and preview canvases.
nav-width: Width of the navigation column: 220px, 176px from 768px to 1023px; below 768px the navigation becomes a top bar.
titlebar-height: Height of the custom window title bar and its 46px-wide window controls.
control-height: Minimum height of buttons, icon buttons, fields and selects: 40px; the Tuner page sets 28px.
settings-index-width: Width of the Tuner's step index column: 196px, 168px from 768px to 1023px.
settings-control-width: Stable control column of a setting row: 232px, 200px from 768px to 1023px.
opacity-disabled: Opacity of a disabled button or switch and of its state label.
shadow-window: Layers that float above the window: the language menu, hint popovers and modal dialogs. Never on in-window sections or cards.
